summary.text: The introduction explains that the casebook contains 64 case studies, each raising a hard ethical issue in planning, reviewing or conducting health research, especially international studies. It is meant to aid teaching, from short workshops to degree courses, and includes a facilitator's guide. It notes growing international concern that health research can both benefit and harm the communities studied.
